relations.rationale: The lunch stop provides the occasion for Esme's comment about the upcoming terrain, but does not itself establish what she said.
Stopping at midday for lunch doesn't imply anything about the afternoon sun's warmth.
The midday lunch stop is a separate event from the frequent breaks taken during the hike.
Esme's statement about a steep climb is the announcement that everyone then nods in agreement to, suggesting the nodding is a response to it.
Everyone nodding in agreement has no bearing on whether Hana holds the position of club secretary.
Kai being taller than Leo says nothing about Pia's height relative to Leo.
A height comparison between Kai and Leo has no connection to when the group starts descending.
Hana pointing out the bird nest directly explains why the group paused to admire it.
Noticing a bird nest has no logical connection to Kai unpacking a thermos of tea.
Pointing out a bird nest has no bearing on Hana's role as club secretary.
Pausing to admire a bird nest earlier in the hike doesn't affect whether the group later reaches the summit.
Stopping to admire a bird nest is unrelated to Kai later sharing tea.
The warm afternoon sun plausibly explains why the group needed frequent breaks to rest and refill water.
The sun growing warm has no clear connection to Leo taking photographs.
The afternoon sun being warm doesn't relate to the timing of the descent as the sky darkens later.
Frequent breaks to rest and refill bottles could plausibly include the sharing of tea from Kai's thermos.
Pia's height relative to Leo has no bearing on the group's overall satisfaction with the hike.
Reaching the summit in late afternoon directly enables the view of the valley spread out in golden light.
Reaching the summit sets up the subsequent descent as the sky darkens.
Reaching the summit precedes and supports the later careful movement back along the rocky path.
